title: Alliant Energy Corporation Announces Fourth Quarter and Year-End 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) has scheduled its fourth quarter and year-end 2025 earnings release for Thursday, February 19 th , after market close. A conference call to review the fourth quarter and year-end 2025 results is scheduled for Friday, February 20 th at 9 a.m. CT. Alliant Energy will webcast the event live at www.alliantenergy.com/investors . The call is open to the public and will be hosted by Lisa Barton, President and CEO; and Robert Durian, Executive Vice President and CFO. Individuals who would like to participate in the conference call can do so by dialing (800) 549-8228 (Toll Free – North America) or (646) 564-2877 (International). The conference ID is 89157. An archive of the webcast will be available on the company’s website at www.alliantenergy.com/investors .
